description: This file defines React components for the header and filter UI of an HTML report viewer, including navigation, settings, and filtering controls.

classes.name: HeaderView
classes.description: React functional component rendering the header with optional superheaders and title.

classes.name: GlobalFilterView
classes.description: React functional component providing a search filter UI with stats navigation.
